title: Java4Shell Remote Code Execution (RCE) Vulnerability - CVE-2026-114938
summary: Elastic is aware of a remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2026-114938, also known as Java4Shell) affecting OpenJDK and Oracle Java SE that was disclosed on November 17, 2026.

title: How security leaders see AI being used in the SOC
summary: Only 18% of teams have structured, enforced frameworks for how AI should be used in the SOC. Security leaders aren't struggling to adopt AI. They're struggling to control it, explain it, and defend it. Learn what you can do to improve AI governance.
